result.summary: Identified two visual issues: image clipping on dish photos and missing text truncation indicator.

issues.description: Dish images (poke, pasta, ramen) are unnaturally clipped on the left edge.
issues.suggestion: Adjust image positioning or CSS object-fit to center assets.

issues.description: The text 'Trattoria Piccol' is cut off without an ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow: ellipsis to long titles.
